Hi Laura / Helixon AP,

Following our procurement sync this morning, we want to propose how Redwood will issue invoices for the upcoming Pilot engagement so your AP system can process payments cleanly across our UK and US legal entities. Summary / ask:

- Redwood will issue two legal-entity invoices for the same PO: one from Redwood Inference Ltd (UK — VAT reg) and one from Redwood Inc (US).
- Each invoice will include clear line-level cost center tags so your internal ledger can allocate spend to product and R&D cost centers.
- Please confirm whether Helixon can provide a single PO that references both invoices, or whether you need two distinct PO numbers per legal entity.
- Confirm Helixon VAT number(s) and whether reverse-charge applies. If so, we will omit UK VAT and include the reverse-charge note.

Attachments: segmentation_matrix.xlsx (proposed line mapping), SOW-Redwood-Helixon.pdf (scope & pricing).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm PO approach + VAT number(s) by end of week.
2) We produce draft invoices and send one consolidated remittance instruction that lists the two beneficiary accounts.
3) You confirm payment terms (we heard Net-30 during negotiation).

If helpful I can create a short mapping doc for your AP import (CSV example).

Thanks,

Evelyn — thanks for the clear note. A few quick answers from AP side:

- Our ERP can accept a single PO referencing multiple invoices, but only if each invoice has a unique invoice number and a billing entity tag. So the approach you outlined should work.
- We prefer separate invoice numbers per legal entity (e.g., INV-2026-Helixon-UK-001 and INV-2026-Helixon-US-001).
- Payment terms: Net-30 is acceptable; please include due date on each invoice for clarity.
- VAT: Helixon Therapeutics is UK VAT-registered (VAT GB987654321). For the UK-entity invoice we will provide our VAT number; if Redwood Inference Ltd issues the UK invoice without VAT we will apply the reverse-charge. For the US invoice we will process without VAT.

Could you send a sample CSV / import line mapping (one row per invoice line) for our AP ingestion? Also please include beneficiary bank details for each entity (we need IBAN for Redwood Inference Ltd).

Regards,
Laura Benton
Finance Director — Helixon Therapeutics
finance@helixon.com

Laura / Marissa / Evelyn — quick VAT and tagging notes from tax: 

- Since Helixon confirmed GB987654321, reverse-charge applies for the UK invoice. Marissa: please ensure the UK invoice includes Helixon's VAT number in the "bill-to" and the reverse-charge annotation (we already have it in the draft).
- For the US invoice we will leave VAT blank and include a US tax residency note. No VAT applies.
- Cost-center tags: please include both the human-readable tag and a 3-char short code in an invoice metadata field (e.g., svc-ml-infer | ML1). The short code helps Helixon's import.
- Remittance: we support a consolidated remittance advice PDF that lists both beneficiary accounts; Helixon can use that to pay via a single transfer if their bank supports multiple beneficiary payments. Otherwise they can pay two separate transfers.

I've uploaded a short example CSV and a one-page guidance doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_drive_link (folder: billing-onboarding/helixon).
